Adds audited, read-only access for eligible doctors to their own completed patient bills, using the owner-approved BIL37 permission and exact migration. Staff-account authority is unchanged. The existing audit allowlist keeps both billing.reviewed and upstream queue.details_viewed plus the invoice identifier.

Preserved as a DRAFT under the owner’s26November2026 request to commit/PR existing work and HOLD all not-started work. Original approved slice is retained with normal main merge c938 and the already reviewed View bill36px desktop/44px mobile target adjustment. No existing assertions changed, no merge performed.

Focused continuation gates:39 backend tests/1130 assertions,2 frontend tests, scoped Pint/PHPStan0 and diff checks passed. Full typecheck/build and latest-main exact-head CI/ancestry remain outstanding; do not merge on historical gates alone. The approved migration is unchanged.

Local packet: /workspace/kpone-review-bundles/bil37-publication/REVIEW.md and manifest.json; main-relative frozen patch SHA2566102872176f8b887a2038f0cd21a9d77dc0da252a085db2a21a23f790a2cc1cf. Branch carries original PR history; no unrelated feature source beyond normal main ancestry.
